lines.beaver_en: Welcome. How is your state of mind right now?
lines.en: I've had deep worries lately, so my heart feels heavy.

lines.beaver_en: Since when? Please take your time.
lines.en: It's been like this since I gave up my dream last year.

lines.beaver_en: May I ask what the dream was?
lines.en: I had a strong desire to become a painter.

lines.beaver: 그 꿈을 접게 된 특별한 사정이 있었나요?
lines.beaver_en: Was there a particular reason you gave up that dream?
lines.beaver_roman: geu kkumeul jeopge doen teukbyeolhan sajeongi isseonnayo?
lines.en: I had a real headache over living expenses.

lines.beaver: 지금도 그 꿈에 마음이 남아 있습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Does your heart still hold on to that dream?
lines.beaver_roman: jigeumdo geu kkume maeumi nama itseumnikka?
lines.learner: 네, 아직도 지난 꿈에 연연하고 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, I'm still clinging to my old dream.
lines.roman: ne, ajikdo jinan kkume yeonyeonhago isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What feelings come up at those times?
lines.learner: 화가 친구들을 보면 동경과 상심이 교차해요.
lines.en: When I see my painter friends, admiration and heartbreak cross paths.
lines.roman: hwaga chingudeureul bomyeon donggyeonggwa sangsimi gyochahaeyo.

lines.beaver: 요즘 마음 상태를 더 말씀해 주시겠어요?
lines.beaver_en: Could you tell me more about how you feel these days?
lines.beaver_roman: yojeum maeum sangtaereul deo malsseumhae jusigesseoyo?
lines.learner: 꿈을 버린 죄책감도 들고, 일상이 권태로워요.
lines.en: I feel guilty for abandoning my dream, and daily life feels dull.
lines.roman: kkumeul beorin joechaekgamdo deulgo, ilsangi gwontaerowoyo.

lines.beaver: 혹시 이런 이야기를 하는 데 거리낌이 있으세요?
lines.beaver_en: Do you have any hesitation talking about this?
lines.beaver_roman: hoksi ireon iyagireul haneun de georikkimi isseuseyo?
lines.learner: 처음엔 있었는데, 이야기하다 보면 편해질 것 같아요.
lines.en: I did at first, but as I keep talking, I think it'll get easier.
lines.roman: cheoeumen isseonneunde, iyagihada bomyeon pyeonhaejil geot gatayo.

lines.beaver: 좋습니다. 요즘 가장 바라는 것은 무엇입니까?
lines.beaver_en: Good. What do you wish for most these days?
lines.beaver_roman: jotseumnida. yojeum gajang baraneun geoseun mueosimnikka?
lines.en: To stop fretting and find peace of mind.

lines.beaver: 꾸준히 마음을 돌보다 보면 평온해지실 거예요.
lines.beaver_en: If you keep caring for your heart, you'll find peace.
lines.beaver_roman: kkujunhi maeumeul dolboda bomyeon pyeongonhaejisil geoyeyo.
lines.en: Thank you. That's been my long-held wish.
